title: Thai-Style Papaya Salad
description: A spicy and sour salad made with shredded green papaya, perfect for a hot summer day.

ingredients.name: Green Papaya
ingredients.notes: Grate or shred the papaya into thin strips

ingredients.name: Thai Chili
ingredients.notes: Use more or less chili depending on desired spice level

ingredients.name: Tam Som Sauce
ingredients.notes: You can make your own tam som sauce or use store-bought

ingredients.name: Papaya Seeds
ingredients.notes: Use seeds as garnish or add to salad for extra flavor

ingredients.name: Som Fruits
ingredients.notes: Chop som fruits into small pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated papaya, diced tomatoes, chopped peanuts, and chopped cilantro.
In a small bowl, whisk together tam som sauce, honeyed peanuts, and papaya seeds. Pour the dressing over the papaya mixture and toss to combine.
Add chopped som fruits and mix well.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, garnish with additional chopped peanuts and cilantro if desired.
